candidates.title: 展示桌全景
candidates.prompt:
Use the supplied images as the character identity and rendering references, and redraw the scene as a NEW sound-science lesson opening illustration. Preserve the warm, detailed hand-painted anime storybook rendering, soft daylight, inviting science classroom, and the EXACT two recurring protagonists. Xiaokui is a brown-eyed schoolgirl with brown DOUBLE BUN hair, natural loose side wisps and bangs, ivory/white hoodie; optional brown/dark backpack straps, no green straps. Grandpa is kindly elderly, fluffy silver-white hair, round thin dark glasses, absolutely CLEAN SHAVEN (no beard or moustache), white lab coat over brown waistcoat and tie. Their anatomy and hands must be natural. This is for Taiwan school unit 3.3 on SOUND CHARACTERISTICS. Wide landscape 16:9 image for a website hero, not a poster or infographic; essential faces and apparatus inside central 85%, no cropped faces, no montage, no title, captions, speech bubbles, letters, numbers, watermarks or logos. Show a single coherent physical activity in one unified scene. The SAME recognizable props must connect to later interactive lessons: (1) a simple wooden monochord sound box with one straight taut string between two bridges and a small movable bridge/tuning peg (string length/tension), (2) three straight hollow cylindrical open-ended pipes of visibly different lengths, same bore/material, on a low tabletop support with open mouths visible (air-column length; NOT water-filled bottles, not a pan flute with sealed bottoms, not test tubes), (3) one compact speaker beside a tablet whose screen has only two clean unlabeled waveform traces with equal spacing but different heights, with simple physical control knobs nearby (amplitude/loudness, frequency/pitch, waveform/timbre, final sound-setting challenge). These are important readable physical objects, not a clutter of unexplained lab glassware. Human listening expressions naturally introduce hearing and sound level; a small pair of dog/bat silhouette reference cards and a simple sound-level meter may sit quietly near a notebook as secondary teaching hints, not animals in the room or a safety/noise lesson. No visible airborne sine waves or magic sound ribbons; the only graph is on the tablet. No meteorite, chemistry flasks, ruler-centred activity, fireworks or unrelated musicians. Let the relationships be physical and clear at a small website display size.

CANDIDATE 01 — EXHIBITION TABLE WIDE ESTABLISHING SCENE. Eye-level three-quarter view across a sunny classroom's wooden sound-exhibition table, Xiaokui on the left and Grandpa on the right as in the references. Xiaokui is gently plucking the clearly visible monochord in the foreground with one hand, her other hand resting clear of its vibrating span; Grandpa leans toward her and gestures invitingly toward the three different-length OPEN pipes displayed to the right. Both look curious and engaged with the table, not at the camera. Tablet and compact speaker are together on the left-back of the tabletop, waveform screen facing the viewer. Notebook and tiny listening-reference cards are discreet at the far back. Balanced broad composition connecting ALL the sound experiments, warm green classroom backdrop and window glow, abundant clean separation between objects. Foreground instrument must not be obscured by elbows. This is the inclusive overview candidate, a deliberate unhurried establishing shot.
